calls.title: ️ Chili Piper Demo for  GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on implementing a more intelligent lead routing system that segments demo requests by company size, location, and visitor data to optimize sales resources. Currently, leads are directed to Account Executives based on availability without proper segmentation, leading to inefficiencies. The proposed strategy includes tailored routing based on employee count and region, utilizing HubSpot CRM data and real-time enrichment from providers like Apollo. Additionally, the integration of Chili Piper’s platform aims to capture leads dynamically while ensuring fair distribution among sales reps through automated processes. A new bundled pricing model was introduced, reflecting a strategic shift towards higher-value deals and enhancing the user experience through enriched data.
calls.keywords: Lead routing, Enrichment, Chili Piper, Demo scheduling, HubSpot integration, Website visitors
